main_measure.name: t of OLS slope of next-day excess return on forecast, forecast>0 bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 with mean timing gain > 0; reject if slope t <= -2; at least 500 bars with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: mean daily timing gain of the book (position x (coin return - coin mean))

decided_by: Slope t is 2 or more and the mean timing gain is above 0, meeting the confirm rule.
reading: The 500-bar minimum counts forecast > 0 bars that have a next-day close in the same window, and the daily book's timing gain is each day's mean over coins of postRebalance_current_allocation x (next-day return - coin mean), averaged over all days.
